items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And we got a guitar player by -- guitar player, he was an ex-GI from World War I, Albert Smith, from New York, and just five of us.

ctx.x: And I found a piano player, the only name I knew, we called him "Kid," that's the only name, I remember. He had never given us his name. Kid, that's all.

And we got a guitar player by -- guitar player, he was an ex-GI from World War I, Albert Smith, from New York, and just five of us. He went back to Belgium, I didn't want to go back to Belgium, but it was just one of those things. That's the business.
And I must say that we had a really wonderful time. We went to Liege.
